## Use this capability when the user means

- get an evidence-based agriculture or water risk brief
- research land production or resilience risk
- investigate an agriculture signal before making a decision
- build a sourced brief about farm water land or production risk

## Authority

public offer discovery and human-confirmed bounded research checkout

## Boundaries

- research is evidence support rather than consequential authority
- unknowns remain labeled
- checkout creation is not payment proof
